openLinAI v2.0.0 更新内容 🐱：\n🌐 新增全界面中文与英文切换:
openLinAI v2.0.0 release notes 🐱:
🌐 Switch the entire interface between Chinese and English, including the workspace, character cards, templates, task management, Studio, settings, and help. Chinese is the default, and your language choice is remembered.
🔤 A language control now appears at the bottom left of the desktop sidebar: “Switch language” in Chinese and “切换语言” in English. When the sidebar is collapsed, only the translation icon is shown.
📱 A language icon is also available in the mobile top bar. Settings dialogs and other browser tabs stay in sync with your language choice.
📝 English text is written by hand and stored locally. User content, prompts, and existing drafts remain in their original language.
openLinAI v2.0.1 更新内容 🐱：\n🌐 英文界面的 107 个内:
openLinAI v2.0.1 release notes 🐱:
🌐 The English interface now uses hand-written English copy for all 107 built-in image styles, sample templates, and default system prompts.
🤖 Internal instructions for NovelAI prompt optimization, image-style extraction, and character cards follow the interface language. Custom prompts stay unchanged.
🖼️ The aspect-ratio instruction appended to image-generation prompts is in English when the interface is in English.
支持文生图、最多 10 张参考图编辑及 1K、1.5K、2K 分辨率: Supports text-to-image, editing with up to 10 reference images, and 1K/1.5K/2K resolution
自动上传参考图并查询异步任务；多图拆成单张请求，质量由模型决定。: Uploads reference images and polls asynchronous tasks automatically. Multiple images use separate requests; quality is determined by the model.
支持最多 3 个 LoRA 地址、0–4 权重和可选 Seed；留空使用基础模型: Supports up to 3 LoRA URLs with weights from 0 to 4 and an optional seed. Leave empty to use the base model.
SpicyAPI 自动上传参考图并查询异步任务，质量由模型决定；比例、分辨率和: SpicyAPI uploads references and polls tasks automatically. Quality is determined by the model; aspect ratio, resolution, and LoRA parameters are validated against its current schema.
留空则随机生成: Leave empty for a random seed
所有 SpicyAPI 模型均可配置；仅填写后发送，数量和权重按当前模型定义校验: Available for all SpicyAPI models. LoRAs are sent only when configured, and validated against the current model schema. Keep the list empty for models without LoRA support.
LoRA 文件或 Hugging Face 的完整 URL: Full URL to a LoRA file or Hugging Face repository
请填写有效的 LoRA URL 和 0–4 权重，或移除空白 LoRA: Enter a valid LoRA URL and a weight from 0 to 4, or remove empty LoRA entries
